configurations.description: Configures the instrumentation to recognize an alternative set of HTTP request methods. All other methods will be treated as `_OTHER`.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.http.known-methods

configurations.description: List of HTTP request headers to capture in HTTP server telemetry.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.http.server.capture-request-headers

configurations.description: List of HTTP response headers to capture in HTTP server telemetry.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.http.server.capture-response-headers

configurations.description: Enable the capture of experimental HTTP server telemetry. Adds the `http.request.body.size` and `http.response.body.size` attributes to spans, and records `http.server.request.body.size` and `http.server.response.body.size` metrics.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.http.server.emit-experimental-telemetry

configurations.description: Enables capturing the experimental `servlet.timeout` span attribute.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.servlet.experimental-span-attributes

configurations.description: Deprecated include-only alias for `otel.instrumentation.servlet.experimental.request-parameters.included`. It does not support glob patterns: an entry containing `*` or `?` is ignored with a warning, and every other entry is matched as a literal request parameter name. It may be removed in the next minor release.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.servlet.experimental.capture-request-parameters

configurations.description: A comma-separated list of case-sensitive request parameter name patterns to exclude from span attributes. `?` matches one character and `*` matches zero or more characters. Excluded patterns take precedence over included patterns. No request parameters are captured unless an included or excluded pattern is configured; configuring only excluded patterns captures all request parameters that do not match them, which may expose sensitive information.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.servlet.experimental.request-parameters.excluded

configurations.description: A comma-separated list of case-sensitive request parameter name patterns to capture as span attributes. `?` matches one character and `*` matches zero or more characters. Excluded patterns take precedence over included patterns. No request parameters are captured unless an included or excluded pattern is configured; configuring only excluded patterns captures all request parameters that do not match them, which may expose sensitive information.
configurations.name: otel.instrumentation.servlet.experimental.request-parameters.included

description: This instrumentation enables HTTP server spans and metrics for IBM WebSphere Liberty application server.
name: liberty-20.0
